title: Word Search in Grid

monster.name: Grid Basilisk
monster.title: Stalker of 4-Directional Word Trails
monster.defeatQuote: DFS backtracking traversed the word without reusing cells!

description: Given an `m x n` grid of characters `board` and a string `word`, return `True` if `word` exists in the grid. The word can be constructed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells (horizontally or vertically). The same letter cell may not be used more than once.
starterCode:
def existWord(board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> bool:
    pass
solutionCode:
def existWord(board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> bool:
    m, n = len(board), len(board[0])
    def dfs(r, c, idx):
        if idx == len(word): return True
        if r < 0 or r >= m or c < 0 or c >= n or board[r][c] != word[idx]: return False
        temp = board[r][c]
        board[r][c] = '#'
        found = dfs(r+1, c, idx+1) or dfs(r-1, c, idx+1) or dfs(r, c+1, idx+1) or dfs(r, c-1, idx+1)
        board[r][c] = temp
        return found
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(n):
            if dfs(i, j, 0): return True
    return False
hints: Mark visited cells with '#' during recursion and restore back upon return.
